before.requirement: Call mbedtls_pk_parse_key with its five declared arguments.
before.reason: The old harness passes the five arguments declared before the change.

after.requirement: Call mbedtls_pk_parse_key with seven arguments, including an RNG callback and context.
after.reason: The old harness still passes five arguments, so its parser call cannot compile against the after declaration.

claims.reason: The same five-argument call satisfies the before declaration and fails the after declaration; the argument-count blocker therefore did not exist before.
